title: Ngā Kaiwhakarongo Huna i Whakapono
intro: I te ata noho o tētahi huihuinga tapu, ka tae mai tētahi huihuinga whakamiharo mai i tētahi ao kāore i kitea. Nā te rongonga i ngā kōrero hāhā mō tētahi mea whakamiharo, ka whakarongo rātou ki tētahi waiata hei hiri i tō rātou aituā ake ake. Ko tā rātou whakaaturanga tētahi o ngā mea tino ahurei i roto i ngā karaipiture tapu.
clues: He iwi tātou nō tētahi ao kāore e kitea e te tini, ā, i haere mai tātou hei rōpū.
I haere mātou ki tētahi huihuinga ki te whakarongo ki tētahi mea whakamiharo.
I tō mātou taenga atu, ka whakarongo mātou ki tētahi whakataki, ā, ka miharo mātou.
I whakaae pūmau mātou ko ētahi o mātou he tika, ko ētahi he hē.
I mōhio mātou e kore e taea e mātou te mawhiti i te ture a te Atua i runga i te whenua, e kore hoki e taea e mātou te rere ki te rangi.
I tō mātou rongonga i te arataki, i whakapono mātou ki reira; ko te tangata e whakapono ana ki tōna Ariki, e kore ia e mataku i te mate, i te taumahatanga rānei.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: He rōpū Jinn
Te Iwi o Irama
Te Iwi o Tubba'
Te Emepaea o Rōma
Te Iwi o Quraysh

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whakarongo ki tētahi karakia tapu
Te hanga i ngā pou teitei i roto i tō tātou tāone
Te hopu i tētahi kamera uha whakamiharo
Te whakangaromanga mō te patu i ō tātou poropiti
Te whakanui i te taonga ki tua atu i te mehua
trial.answer: Te whakarongo ki tētahi karakia tapu

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He huihuinga mō te karakia tapu
He tāone o ngā pou teitei (Iram)
He puna i te koraha
He whare nui koura
He ana tapu i ngā maunga
location.answer: He huihuinga mō te karakia tapu

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakapono mātou, ā, i whakatūpato hoki i tō mātou iwi
I whakangaromia e te pahūtanga nui mai i te rangi
I whiua e te hau werawera, whakangaro
I whakawhiwhia ki te taonga nui me te mana nui
I noho pūmau i roto i te kore whakapono
outcome.answer: I whakapono mātou, ā, i whakatūpato hoki i tō mātou iwi

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
